name: Onboarding Tour: empty state, then the no_data outline for the never-cloned seeded repo (SPEC-02 AC-104, AC-105)
description: From the PR list, open 'Onboarding Tour' in the WORKSPACE sidebar group and confirm the page at /repos/<id>/onboarding shows the empty state titled 'Generate onboarding tour' (AC-104). Then click the 'Generate onboarding tour' button: the seeded repo acme/payments-api has no clone and no index (e2e/docs/insights.md), so the generation ends `no_data` WITHOUT any model call and the page shows the no_data banner sentence of AC-87 (AC-105). The URL wait is the per-repo pattern, never a bare '/onboarding', which is the add-repository screen (flow 06). The sidebar click keeps --exact because Next.js inlines the next-intl messages blob into a <script> tag that a non-exact `find text` can resolve to instead of the real link. Needs a freshly-seeded DB with no stored tour (use e2e:hermetic): a tour left in a dev DB would skip the empty state. Read-only apart from the one generation POST, which stores a skeleton row; no LLM, no API key.

steps.label: land on the first repo's PR list
open Onboarding Tour from the WORKSPACE sidebar group
navigate to the tour route (the empty-state check below rules out the add-repository screen)
AC-104: the empty state titled 'Generate onboarding tour' renders
request the generation (the seeded repo has no clone, so no model is called)

cmd: No index for this repository yet — showing an outline built without AI.
